page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture configured with 2 dedicated vCPUs and 2 physical cores, resulting in 1.0 thread per core. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage volumes. It also does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The CPU configuration lacks advanced instruction set extensions such as AVX, AVX-512, AMX, and hardware-accelerated cryptography flags like AES or SHA_NI.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.s2.xlarge is designed for entry-level general-purpose workloads. It is suitable for lightweight web serving, small databases, development environments, and basic microservices. The lack of specialized hardware accelerators and advanced CPU instruction sets positions this instance as a cost-efficient option for standard utility computing tasks that do not require high-performance vector processing or local disk I/O.
